name: Handout 2: The Vault Inscription
player_description:
TIWAZ — HAGALAZ — NAUDHIZ — ISA — OTHALAN
War — Disruption — Need — Stillness — Ancestral Land

Here lies the God-Killer, the Spear of Broken Oaths, sealed by the blood of heroes. May it never taste sunlight again.

Forged in vengeance. Quenched in divine blood. The son of Mars fell here. His father's wrath lingers still.

(Scratched at the base, as if done in haste:)
DO NOT WAKE WHAT SLEEPS HERE.
gm_notes:
WHEN: Session 1, when the party reaches the altar stone at the base of the shaft.
HOW: Draw the Elder Futhark rune row on textured cardstock, script inscription beneath in a rougher hand.
WHAT IT REVEALS: The spear is an artifact of violence against a divine lineage. Deliberately sealed. Someone wanted it found by no one. The five runes (TIWAZ-HAGALAZ-NAUDHIZ-ISA-OTHALAN) also appear on Handout 6 (Thusnelda's map) — players who connect them get advantage on the Session 4 grove ritual Religion check.
